messages:
Anya R: Quick design thought — what if we add a small, collapsible 'schema inspector' inline in the Run History rows so users can peek tool output schemas without opening the editor?

Mike L: Love the idea. Main ask: keyboard focus needs to land in the inspector and ESC should close it. Also visual affordance for "has schema" state in the row (dot or badge).

Sara K: Implementation note: inspector should render sanitized JSON schema preview and a 'show full in editor' link. We can reuse existing schema renderer. Example preview:
```
{ "name": "order_response", "type": "object", "properties": {"id":"string", "total":"number"}}
```

Raj P: +1. Also suggest a copy tweak: change 'schema' label to 'structured output schema' in the tooltip to reduce confusion with function defs.

Anya R: Good call. Also accessibility nit: the preview panel should announce 'Structured output preview' via aria-live when opened and we should include role="dialog" and focus trap for keyboard users.

Mike L: And add a setting to disable auto-expand for users who prefer compact run history (per feedback from power users). Default should remain collapsed.

Sara K: Dev question — should the inspector support tool-call examples? i.e. render sample invocation with args? That would help debugging and make run history more useful.

Anya R: Yes, show a small 'sample input / sample output' toggle. Keep collapsed by default and lazy-load examples to avoid perf hit.

playground-bot: deploy-check: run-tests ok on branch mini-schema-panel (CI passed)

Raj P: Copy suggestion for the toggle label: 'Sample input & output' -> shorter 'Examples'. Also we should ensure screen reader announces when examples finish loading.

Anya R: :thumbsup: I'll update the Figma, add keyboard interaction diagram, and file an accessibility checklist. Will also add a tiny microcopy change for the row state: 'Has structured output' -> 'Has output schema' to be even clearer. Thanks team!
